subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram opening MP(I)-9 — the section connecting alternative-creativity to political-consciousness in the sixties. The prose below the diagram identifies what the crossing diagrams: 'there was, of course, a relationship between alternative creativity and the emergence of political consciousness in the sixties. For the realness of this period in time would establish a particular vibrational state that permeated the composite spectrum of "doing."' The crossing diagrams that relationship structurally: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism — the form's actual working) is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics — the actual political-working the form gets crossed with). ALT-FT sits on the left with the subject-arrow; DIS-C-CT (disconnect) rises above and ACT (action) sits at top-right with UNF-PI (unified physical-information-implication) on the right margin and ACC-FT (accumulated functionalism) below — the partner-side's upper outputs. RT-ALGN (reality alignment) sits centrally below the subject, with DEF (definition) hanging immediately below RT-ALGN and SOC-RT-INT (social-reality internal) at the lower-left as the subject's downward chain. INFO-TRNS (information-transition) sits centrally as the bridging hub; POL-DY is partner-axis at center-right with TRS (transformation) on the right and LK-IMP (linkage implication) at the bottom-center as bridging terminus. Structural argument: when alternative-functionalism is crossed with political-dynamics in the sixties, the partner's upper chain DIS-C-CT → ACT → UNF-PI / ACC-FT is the route by which alternative-creativity's *action* gets converted into unified-physical-implication and accumulated-functionalism — the actual political reading the sixties gave. The subject's downward chain RT-ALGN → DEF and SOC-RT-INT is what alternative-functionalism produces on its own — reality-alignment routes through definition into social-reality-internal. The central diagonal SOC-RT-INT → INFO-TRNS → POL-DY → TRS is the *bridging route* — social-reality-internal supplies the information-transition that POL-DY converts into transformation. LK-IMP at the bottom is the load-bearing terminus: information-transition reaches linkage-implication only when the bridging hub holds. The 'vibrational state that permeated the composite spectrum of doing' the prose names is precisely the bridging hub doing exactly this work — without INFO-TRNS, the upper chain absorbs alternative-functionalism's action into political-dynamics on the partner side alone, and the linkage-implication that would make the sixties' alternative-creativity politically coherent never arrives.
